Privacy

We collect what the job needs: your name, phone, email, where the boat is, equipment details, photos you choose to send, and your description of the problem. We share it only with the mechanic assigned to your job and with our payment processor, Stripe, which handles card and bank details; we never see them.

If you check the texting box we may text you about your job; reply STOP to opt out. We do not sell your information. Email help@tampabayboatmechanics.com to ask what we hold or to have it deleted.

This site uses standard server logs and, if enabled, Google Analytics to count visits.
